notationConventions.raw: Provisional manual reading of scanned four-part tonic sol-fa; printed underlines, note divisions and dynamic markings require review.
notationConventions.playbackInterpretation: Approximate evenly distributed timing per printed grouping; not verified.

issues.description: Exact note timing and held notes not fully decoded; uniform subdivisions are placeholders.
Small octave and chromatic marks need source comparison.
Each visible printed column is represented as a provisional group, not necessarily a complete metrical bar.

dataContract.sourceOfTruth: measures[].voices[voice].notes with raw source notation preserved

transcriptionStatus.notes: Four-part provisional scan transcription. Check all bars against printed original before production playback.

noteRegeneration.source: displayRaw (as edited by the user, unchanged)
noteRegeneration.method: token-based SATB note rebuild; each : or | is a rhythmic-cell boundary; MIDI pitches mapped from do and octave marks; rhythmic dots and holds interpreted
noteRegeneration.timeBase: absolute (full-bar source coordinates, corrected for pickups by app timing module)
noteRegeneration.attention: 3/4/4/4/6/8 meters and fine dotted/subdivided figures were interpreted from existing JSON; the printed score may require further manual timing validation.
